# Non-Archimedean Bedford–Taylor Theory

A source-linked research programme. Original mathematical source edition: 2026-11-16. Unsigned website reading edition: 2026-11-18.

## Read first
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/: complex background, non-Archimedean motivation and central problem
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/conjectures/: exact conjectures, questions and research problems
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/programme/: research directions and their next mathematical steps
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/papers/research-program/: full formal programme, exact conjectures and known cases
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/papers/bedford-taylor-products/: full core article with proofs
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/results/: six main groups of results with their proof links
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/results/catalogue/: all 74 source-bound topic groups
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/comparison/: complex benchmarks, internal results, gaps and exact counterexamples
- https://dongkaicheng.github.io/math-research-atlas/projects/bedford-taylor/editions/v1.0.1/sources/#status: evidence and mathematical-status policy

## Interpretation
The project retains the original finite K/Q_p, norm, ordinary topology, original test class and actual refinements. Source completion does not imply independent proof acceptance. General analytic relation descent and general normal-three central cancellation remain open. Mathematical source and publication status are separate. Historical R21 original complete ZIP/PDF remains unrecovered.

This public reading edition is read-only. Feedback is submitted through the atlas’s shared GitHub Issues; reader comments do not modify the mathematical corpus.
